answers.rationale: The requirement specifies detailed wiring and terminal block standards for metal-clad switchgear. CROWN-ARMV is the appropriate product as it is arc-resistant metal-clad MV switchgear built to IEEE C37.20.2, which aligns with the detailed specifications provided.

The requirement for control power buses within the switchgear assembly aligns with the functionality of CROWN-ARMV, which is designed for metal-clad MV switchgear applications and includes provisions for control power distribution.

The requirement for factory testing and functional verification of relays, meters, and other components is a standard part of the offering for CROWN-ARMV, which includes comprehensive testing as part of its engineered-to-order process.

The requirement for wire labeling and identification is consistent with the detailed engineering and manufacturing processes of CROWN-ARMV, which adheres to high standards for wiring and labeling in metal-clad switchgear.
